title: Company Closure: fixes after testing the whole flow on real data
text: Problems found while testing Company Closure from start to finish were fixed. A company can no longer be closed by accident: moving a job to Closing now asks first. Unpaid invoices are cancelled the same way Finance's Void does it, and an invoice that is part-paid is left open and reported. If something goes wrong while closing, a note is left on the job instead of the warning disappearing.
points: The step bar and Go Back now say what a move does, for example that going back deletes the saved IRS tracking number and that a finished closure's company stays Closed.
Upload boxes in the client's closure form refuse files that are not documents, and empty or fake PDFs. Tracking numbers are saved without spaces.
If the client's EIN differs from our record, staff get a note instead of being blocked. For a company that is not ours, staff can fix a typo in the name or EIN first.
